notes: "Before delivering, run Design check. It reads the whole collection and reports observations: type sizes outside the range you chose, unexpected backgrounds, Sections without a title slide, images with too few pixels for the size they are shown at. It is read-only; you still look at the slides yourself. Present starts from the beginning with F5 or from the current slide with Shift+F5, in a full-screen window with click builds. Export takes the slides as saved when it starts. The project folder itself is the editable source. PPTX keeps supported objects native, so a co-author can keep editing text, tables and basic charts in PowerPoint; animation becomes static. PDF is for sharing, and MP4 plays the click builds on a timer. This deck was exported to PDF and PPTX in exactly this way."

designIntent.purpose: Show Design check, the Present menu and Export, with what each output carries.
keep: Design check crop is a pixel-exact derivative (media/derived)
Output capabilities as stated in the project README
